title: eremostachys molucelloides subsp. macrophylla
intro: Eremostachys molucelloides subsp. macrophylla, commonly known as the Tibetan thyme or Himalayan thyme, is a plant species in the family Lamiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine in the Himalayan region for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Eremostachys molucelloides subsp. macrophylla include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. Additionally, it has been used to treat various conditions, including fever, cough, and digestive issues, due to its therapeutic actions, which include expectorant and anti-inflammatory effects.
